nonblocking_findings.finding: The U audio probes require explicitly selected relevant controls but do not pin their selected settings or a witnessed active-processing positive control. For example the asymmetric-channel probe can be masked by main Dry/Wet0, Ratio1, Glue Range0, disabled bands/Amount0, or Listen replacing the normal output. No false pass is currently asserted: all such expected values are null and the spec explicitly requires later measurement/oracle work.
nonblocking_findings.requested_follow_up: Before execution or promotion to acceptance cases, retain accepted displayed settings, the intended normal/detector/listen output path, and an active-processing control for each branch. Separate deliberate bypass/neutral branches from active response probes; do not infer legal control values or calibrated detector levels.

nonblocking_findings.finding: The rate matrix requests44100/48000/96000Hz but S2 is defined only as48000frames at48000Hz with its impulse at frame24000. It does not choose unchanged-frame reinterpretation, regenerated time-aligned impulse or host resampling for the other rates. Those choices produce different input timing/duration, so this is not yet a unique executable time/latency fixture. The oracle is correctly null.
nonblocking_findings.requested_follow_up: Pin frames, impulse index, duration and any host resampling/source-rate behavior separately at each rate before collecting comparable timing evidence. Keep unavailable rate/block requests and observed host behavior distinct.
